verdict.rationale: Evidence explicitly shows no official Epic MCP server/client integration exists (GitHub search for 'mcp org:EpicGames' returns 0 results), and the top community-built MCP bridges for Unreal (chongdashu/unreal-mcp, kvick-games/UnrealMCP) are unmaintained since 2025. No first-party or actively maintained mechanism lets Unreal consume MCP server tools.
